# dependencytrack_secret_metadata (Data Source)

Fetch metadata for a Secret. Requires API >= 5.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dependencytrack_secret_metadata" "example" {
  name = "secret-name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Secret.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Millisecond timestamp of when the Secret was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the Secret.
- `updated_at` (Number) Millisecond timestamp of when the Secret was most-recently updated, if at all.
